name: applicant.manualOffer.update.v2
description: This method provides the offers given manually to the student or revokes it. This can include the offer types - MANUAL, APPEAL, WAITLIST

steps.description: If epStageId is not provided, fetch the current epStageId, closed for the epId using enrollment.stage.get.forCurrentRound for applicationType = CHOICES

properties.value:
select ac.program_id as "prevOfferedProgram", a.details as "prevOfferDetails" ,
json_build_object (
           'programId', p.id,
           'programName', p."name" ,
           'programCode', p.code 
       ) AS "placeholderLogRemove"
from application a  
LEFT JOIN
    applied_choices ac ON a.id = ac.application_id
LEFT JOIN
    non_applied_choices nac ON a.id = nac.application_id 
left  join "program" p on ac.program_id = p.id 
where 
	a.ep_stage_id ='#{currentEpStageId}'
	AND a.student_id ='#{studentId}'
    AND a.state  = 'SUBMITTED'
    AND a.is_active  = true
    AND a.deleted = false
    AND ac.offer_details->'#{offerType}' IS NOT null
properties.name: SQLQuery

steps.description: Validate that the access is allowed by calling student.manualOffer.isUpdateAllowed method

properties.value:
SELECT current_grade + 1 AS "applyingGrade"
FROM student where id ='#{studentId}'
properties.name: SQLQuery
